$comment: Behavioral: build a manifest-rooted CARv1 evidence bundle from role-tagged artifacts, encode, decode, and recompute every block CID. `expected` is the ordered manifest entries (role + lcp:sha256: ref) recovered after the roundtrip — the refs are SHA-256 of the artifact bytes (semantic-derived, deterministic), so a bundle whose blocks no longer hash to their manifest refs fails integrity. Consumed by evidence's package tests (not a conformance corpus area — the cross-party byte formats are carDeterminism + cidAtrHash).

cases.name: atr + referenced terms + signed acceptance roundtrips; manifest refs recompute
